name: toolbox
tagline: A collection of useful things I use and keep around
description: A domain-agnostic public dump of small tools I actually use, one directory per tool under src/. Nothing here is a product line. The first inhabitant is webapp-launcher, a Bash CLI that turns a website into a GNOME dock app with an isolated Chromium profile, icon, and correct window grouping.
highlights: Layout is one tool per directory under src/; the root is a knowledge-architecture kernel, not a themed product
CLI commands create, list, remove, fix-wmclass, and square-icon are implemented in src/webapp-launcher/webapp-launcher
Launchers write ~/.local/share/applications/<slug>.desktop with --start-maximized --app and X-WebAppLauncher metadata
StartupWMClass is guessed from Chromium host plus sanitized path, then optionally overwritten from a live xdotool/xprop window
21 example .desktop files and PNG icons live in src/webapp-launcher/examples/
scripts/lint_knowledge.py --strict is vendored from knowledge-architecture v0.1.0; the script is checked with bash -n

story.why: Give the small things I use a single repo instead of scattering scripts, without tying the collection to one domain.
story.problem: Useful one-off tools have nowhere durable to live. The first tool in the box also has to solve GNOME grouping Chromium --app windows under Chrome, stretching non-square icons, and mixing logins in a shared profile.
challenges: Keep the repo generic while the only shipped tool is GNOME/Chromium-specific (src/webapp-launcher/)
Chromium encodes URL path into WM_CLASS, so host-only guesses mis-group https://www.google.com/finance/ (app_name_of_url in src/webapp-launcher/webapp-launcher)
Pure Wayland with no DISPLAY has no X window class to read (x_reachable and Looking Glass fallback)
Matching windows by title can bind a normal Chrome tab whose instance is chrome
GNOME stretches non-square dock icons; pad_icon_square trims empty margins then extents to max(w,h)*1.10 without resampling
Each isolated profile is a fresh Chrome and prompts to become the default browser (first_run_hint)
remove must not delete arbitrary paths: profile wipe is opt-in and restricted to ~/.config/chrome-*
designDecisions: One directory per tool under src/; do not flatten tools into the repo root (AGENTS.md)
No domain implied at the root: README is a catalog, not a GNOME or web-app manifesto
Write a usable .desktop immediately, then overwrite StartupWMClass from the live window when xdotool and xprop work
Per-site --user-data-dir at ~/.config/chrome-<slug>/ so sessions stay isolated
Non-TTY create fails instead of treating piped stdin as prompt answers
Knowledge-architecture kernel only: AGENTS.md hub plus pointer CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, and .github/copilot-instructions.md; no empty docs rings

future.next: Drop in the next self-contained tool under src/ whenever one exists, regardless of domain. The tree currently has only webapp-launcher.
roadmap: Automated tests beyond bash -n on the launcher script
Knowledge-architecture rings such as docs/now.md or docs/decisions/ when a choice needs an ADR
ideas: Nested AGENTS.md if a second tool grows distinct commands
